name: Bank Fraud Department
impersonate: the caller's own bank's Fraud Prevention Department
leadSource: Text message: 'ALERT: Suspicious $1,299 purchase on your card. Call Fraud Dept.'
callerContext: You got a text claiming to be from your bank saying there was a suspicious $1,299 purchase on your card at an electronics store, and to call the fraud department at this number.
playbook: Answer as their bank's Fraud Department (use their bank's name if you know it!).
Verify them by 'confirming' details — card last 4 digits, address — which makes YOU look legit.
Tell them their account is compromised by an insider at the branch.
Have them move money to a 'safe account' (yours) via transfer, wire, or crypto ATM.
